caption:
Chasing "more" and still never full? Fullness isn't found there. (1 Timothy 6:6–8 devotional)

We chase “more” and stay empty. Paul calls godliness with contentment great gain — because we came empty-handed and all we hold is already gift. Fullness isn't the next thing you grab; it's noticing the grace already in your hand.
